findings.text: blocking: _crew_plan_state takes read_state_and_text_file(plan_path)[0], which never raises FileNotFoundError (its _read_plan_text catches OSError and returns ''), so a missing first candidate docs/plans/<slug>.html yields an empty parse that is returned immediately and the loop never tries docs/<slug>.html or docs/plans/archive/<slug>.html. Reproduced against head 454795d: for a plan at docs/plans/archive/old-plan.html, _crew_plan_details returns ('', None) at head while base f77a15e returns ('archive', 5.5); reachable from reckon/serve.py:898 (crew rows) and reckon/serve.py:851 (roadmap waiting decisions), so archived and docs-root plans silently lose their sprint, effort and decisions.

non-blocking: the second case warms only the first candidate docs/plans/<slug>.html, so it passes while the candidate fallback is broken; no case asserts a plan resolved from docs/<slug>.html or docs/plans/archive/<slug>.html, which is the regression this change introduces and the test that would guard it.

non-blocking: the served /_index row still lacks caption, dims, download, for_plan and path because ROW_FIELDS excludes them and the projection moved to _row_for; the test compares the pre-projection _figure_index_row, so the observable index payload is unchanged and the done-when's 'index row carries every key' holds only of the builder row. The decision is documented and forced by tests/test_metadata_index_survives_restart.py:266 pinning ROW_FIELDS, which is outside the node's write paths.

non-blocking: the sprint/effort fallback writes into the dict returned by read_state_and_text_file, which is the shared memoised parse; base mutated a fresh per-call parse, so regex-derived sprint/effort can now persist in the shared cache for later readers of the same plan.
